run_query: run the query function to send an image file to the Hugging Face NSFW image detection API
create_query_function: create a query function that reads an image file and POSTs it to a Hugging Face inference endpoint
test_query: test the query function with a JPEG image file and verify the JSON response from the inference API
build_headers_config: build an Authorization headers dict using a Bearer token from the HF_TOKEN environment variable
summarize_response: summarize the JSON response returned by the Hugging Face inference API after posting an image
